Yes, this matches my intent. I flagged the pasta recipe as "Read later," then clicked the "Read later" view above the list and landed on just that one bookmark — exactly the focused list I wanted for the stuff I keep meaning to get back to. And your two assumptions feel right: having the flag sit right on each bookmark is natural, and I like that a read-later item still lives in my full collection while also showing up in its own view — I wouldn't want flagging something to pull it out of my main list.

One thing I want to make sure we cover as we go — not blocking this: once I've actually read one of these, I'd want a way to mark it as read so it drops off the read-later list. The setting it aside part is right; I just want the other half, clearing it, when you get to it. Good to continue.
